text:
kevin: quick q — trying to wire a k8s Secret into our service via helm; chart has `extraEnv` but i'm not sure if i should put the secret name/key in values.yaml or reference a pre-created Secret.

sophie: prefer not to put raw secrets in values.yaml. create the Secret with Terraform or a k8s manifest and reference it from the chart via valueFrom.secretKeyRef.

ajay: +1. if TF manages the Secret, add `depends_on` to the `helm_release` so helm waits for the secret. example: `depends_on = [kubernetes_secret.svc_creds]` in the release resource.

kevin: ok — how does the values.yaml look? chart expects `extraEnv` list, not `valueFrom` objects.

maria: depends on chart. if the chart template supports `env` objects you can pass:
``
secrets:
  name: svc-credentials
  key: api_token
extraEnv:
  - name: API_TOKEN
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: "{{ .Values.secrets.name }}"
        key: "{{ .Values.secrets.key }}"
```
but if the chart only accepts key/value pairs you might need to update the template or use `extraEnvFrom`.

kevin: chart is upstream (community) and only has `extraEnv` as name/value map. we don't want to fork. any workaround?

sophie: two options:
1) use a small patch (kustomize or helm post-renderer) to inject `valueFrom` blocks — lightweight.
2) create a second secret with the token as env var-style (stringData) and mount via `envFrom.secretRef`. terraform can create that.

ajay: also consider `helm_release.set` -> but don't put secret values there. you can set the secret name via `set { name = "secrets.name" value = "svc-credentials" }` and keep the key config in values, then rely on the template to do valueFrom. only safe if chart template supports it.

infra-bot: lint: helm chart `svc-chart` template does not support `extraEnv.valueFrom` (helm lint rule). will fail on install unless chart patched.

kevin: got it. i'll try creating the env-style secret with terraform and add depends_on to the release. thanks!

sophie: ping here once you have the TF changes and i'll review the helm_release bits :thumbsup:

kevin: will do. thanks all :pray:
